859.description:
School are asking for donations of individually wrapped cakes and biscuits (due to allergies) to be sent into school by Thursday 24th September. Use by date to be at least Friday 25th September.

Every child in the school will be taking part to support this event in their classroom, they will not be coming into the hall.  

School are asking for a donation to Macmillan Cancer Relief per child which will include a drink and biscuits or cake, and per adult as part of the coffee morning.
